name: University of Washington, Seattle
header:
University of Washington, Seattle
United States · Mathematics PhD (pure mathematics; separate Applied Mathematics program has different deadlines)
Rank verified separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Pure Mathematics deadline is December 9, not the separate Applied Mathematics deadlines.
• Fee-waiver pages disagree: use Graduate School's seven-day lead time.
• Faculty list below is an evidence-checked shortlist, not a complete supervisor census. Availability to accept a
2027 student is unconfirmed.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in degree category after completing UChicago bachelor's; minimum 3.0 overall or last 90 quarter/60
semester graded credits. Mathematics GPA 3.5 recommended; 45 quarter credits beyond precalculus,
including rigorous algebra and real analysis. International/F-1 applicants accepted. Individual record not
assessed. [s2] [s3]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Create UW application; choose Mathematics PhD/Autumn 2027; ask referees before entering details; prepare
uploads and waiver request if eligible. [s2] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Admissions questions: gradmath@uw.edu. Individual 2027 advising capacity unconfirmed; contact relevant
faculty after reading their work. No prior supervisor agreement requirement found. [s1] [s9]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public program listing confirms program, term, three recommendations, resume and SOP. Application FAQ
explains referee notices and receipt. Uploaded statements cannot be edited after submission without program
assistance. [s2] [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Department explicitly updated September 30, 2026 for Fall 2027; program portal independently confirms
December 9, 2026. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Non-native speakers must demonstrate English proficiency; TA appointments have an additional
spoken-English standard. Policy 3.2 accepts qualifying English-medium degrees with in-person residency; US
degrees need no separate medium-of-instruction letter. [s8] [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago degree conferred before entry satisfies the graduate English requirement; leave test section blank
and submit final degree-bearing transcript when requested. Department also lists US bachelor's route for TA
English qualification. [s4] [s1]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Not considered (public Mathematics PhD program listing). [s2]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
Program's GRE policy is Not Considered; no subject-score exception listed. [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
Math TAs use regular Schedule 1; department does not publish a fixed incoming-2027 yearly stipend on
admissions page. Tuition waived except approximately USD 450 required fees per quarter; base salary plus
possible supplementary awards. Retrieve current schedule and offer before budgeting. [s7] [s17]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Renewal reviewed each May; multi-year guarantee and summer coverage not verified. Published academic TA
dates span September 16-June 15; summer assignment, when offered, June 16-August 15. [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International applicants can receive TA support if English appointment conditions met; UChicago bachelor's
provides the stated degree route. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
50% FTE; maximum 220 hours/quarter; in-person work. Renewal depends on academic progress and teaching
evaluation. Promotion after core-course milestones or general exam. [s7]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Separate incoming mathematics TA application not verified; non-Math TA application discussed on funding
page is not an incoming mathematics-admissions instruction. [s7]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
RA appointments and external fellowships also used; individual eligibility and amounts depend on award. [s1]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 90, nonrefundable, each application; online Mastercard/Visa credit/debit. [s6]
Fee waiver [Conflict]
F-1/J-1 holders are ineligible for need-based Graduate School waiver. Program-based routes include
McNair/PPIA and Math Alliance Predoctoral/MSRI-UP. Graduate School says request at least seven days before

deadline; department says five. Safer cutoff: December 2, 2026 (derived). Do not pay before waiver decision;
fees are not refunded. [s1] [s5]
